name: King of the Barfog Hills

facts.text: Level 65, 30,000 health, immune to crowd control; casts Crush.

story: Nobody crowned the King of the Barfog Hills. He crowned himself, the hill-folk say, the day the ladies of the lake took their cattle home and left the slopes above Llyn Barfog without anyone to keep them. He has kept them since, after his fashion. He walks his hill as a king walks his hall, and the grass lies flat where he has trodden, and anything that comes onto it without bowing is crushed. He cannot be charmed, or mesmerized, or stunned; a king does not take orders.
legend: A straight fight with a heavy hitter: his Crush lands hard on whoever he is facing. He cannot be crowd controlled at all, so do not plan around a mez. Tank, heal and burn, and stay off his hill until you mean it.

phases.text: A king does not yield his hill!

lairEntry: A king's hill. The grass is flattened by his tread.
